shared_elements: circular disc/sun motif as a dominant element
framed panel with figures arranged beneath/around a central disc
horizontal registers or bands of decoration
small repeated figures in a row
justification: Both surfaces are organised as framed panels dominated by a large circular disc with subordinate figures and horizontal registers beneath it, but A's disc is an abstract whirling multi-armed rosette ringed by dots and accompanied only by tiny schematic quadrupeds and running wave/scroll borders, while B shows a figural scene of standing human figures with offerings, an altar-like table, small attendant figures and dense rows of sign-like script under an arched sun/disc. The only correspondence is the generic one of a big circle above a band of smaller figures; the depicted subjects (pure geometric ornament with animals vs. a human ritual scene with inscriptions) are entirely different.
